newsitem.title: DENMARK: SAS, Lufthansa to sell new airpass.
newsitem.headline: SAS, Lufthansa to sell new airpass.

text.p: Scandinavian Airlines System (SAS) said on Tuesday it planned along with German strategic partner Lufthansa to introduce a special new StopEurope Airpass ticket this summer.
It said the new ticket type, to be available initially from May 15 to August 31, would allow passengers to stop off in several countries on the way to final destinations.
SAS said the new ticket deal would also be available for passengers flying on routes five airlines with which it and Lufthansa collaborated in Europe, flew.
The seven airlines fly to a total of 141 destinations. The five airlines collaborating with SAS and Lufthansa in Europe are British Midland, Luxair, Air Baltic, Spanair and Air Dolomiti.
